CRITICAL.label: CRITICAL
CRITICAL.message: Immediate engineering review is required before release, programming or warranty authorization.

POOR.label: POOR
POOR.message: Corrective action and repeat verification are required.

FAIR.label: FAIR
FAIR.message: The configuration is usable for review but contains open actions.

GOOD.label: GOOD
GOOD.message: No critical configuration action is indicated by the available evidence.

disclaimers: The Engineering Assistant is rule based and does not replace OEM diagnostic procedures.
The output is not an automatic warranty, replacement, programming or vehicle-release authorization.
Dependency and root-cause results must be verified against the official vehicle E/E architecture.
